exact_runtime_prompt_en: A campus-life photograph of university students working together in a university ceramics teaching studio. The main woman uses the supplied reference for face and hair: her facial features follow the supplied reference, and her short dark bob and fine wispy fringe follow the supplied reference. Her quiet, attentive presence is the visual center, with a small pleased smile directed toward a spacing problem the team has just solved. Three students gather around a waist-high workbench holding a cold circular kiln shelf. They are university students at a shared practical assignment. The main student steadies one pale, unglazed hand-built jug with her left hand at its lower wall while a teammate on the opposite side rotates the neighboring handled bowl with both hands. The two vessels remain upright on the flat shelf, and a clear finger-width gap has opened between their adjacent handles. Each acting forearm remains connected to its owner's body and the shelf and both contact points are visible together. A third teammate, standing at the right end of the bench, looks between that same arrangement and a paper firing-layout diagram while drawing the corresponding two vessel positions with a pencil. The sheet rests on the bench immediately beside the shelf. Behind them, open racks hold repeated student clay test pieces and individual labeled work boards; a studio board headed CERAMICS II displays a course timetable, a pinned critique sheet and a small firing-layout sketch. This is an inhabited teaching room with worn wooden worktops, clay dust and aprons hung beside shared tools. The main subject wears a plain slate shirt with rolled sleeves and a clay-marked work apron. Photograph from slightly above bench height in a medium-wide three-quarter view, giving the face, both vessels, the connected hands and the paper plan enough space to read together. Soft afternoon window light models the main face and catches the dry clay edges; the shared problem remains the center of attention. Natural skin texture, warm neutral color and restrained documentary realism.
